inputs.spec_clause_ref: kerml clause 8.2.3.4.2 (Imports.md, region_sha256 a2610efd00be16cc) | sysml clause 8.2.2.5.1 (Packages.md, region_sha256 3ee603b1b89d4345)

decision: A membership import or a namespace import, as KerML 8.2.3.4.2 and SysML 8.2.2.5.1 both state it.
notes:
Both languages agree on the body. A notational slip in the KerML clause, recorded because it would trip anyone reading it literally: `ImportDeclaration : Import` is followed by its body with no `=`, where every other production, and SysML's statement of this one, has it. Nothing about what parses turns on it.

There is no Xtext rule of this name; the pilot distributes the two alternatives into its Import rule.

FOR A PARSER AUTHOR: the two alternatives share a leading qualified name and are told apart only after it — `::*` makes a NamespaceImport, anything else a MembershipImport — and `[` opens the filter-package form of NamespaceImport.

FILED WITH OMG: the notational slip recorded above is KERML11-108, item 1. It concerns how the rule is written, not what it accepts, so it is recorded as a citation and not as a deviation.
